67: /**
68:  * Handles the {@link ExtensionMethod} annotation for javac.
69:  */
70: @Provides
71: @HandlerPriority(66560) // 2^16 + 2^10; we must run AFTER HandleVal which is at 2^16
72: public class HandleExtensionMethod extends JavacAnnotationHandler<ExtensionMethod> {
73: 	@Override
74: 	public void handle(final AnnotationValues<ExtensionMethod> annotation, final JCAnnotation source, final JavacNode annotationNode) {
75: 		handleExperimentalFlagUsage(annotationNode, ConfigurationKeys.EXTENSION_METHOD_FLAG_USAGE, "@ExtensionMethod");
76: 		
77: 		deleteAnnotationIfNeccessary(annotationNode, ExtensionMethod.class);
78: 		JavacNode typeNode = annotationNode.up();
79: 		boolean isClassOrEnumOrInterface = isClassOrEnumOrInterface(typeNode);
80: 		
81: 		if (!isClassOrEnumOrInterface) {
82: 			annotationNode.addError("@ExtensionMethod can only be used on a class or an enum or an interface");
83: 			return;
84: 		}
85: 		
86: 		boolean suppressBaseMethods = annotation.getInstance().suppressBaseMethods();
87: 		
88: 		List<Object> extensionProviders = annotation.getActualExpressions("value");
89: 		if (extensionProviders.isEmpty()) {
90: 			annotationNode.addError(String.format("@%s has no effect since no extension types were specified.", ExtensionMethod.class.getName()));
91: 			return;
92: 		}
93: 		final List<Extension> extensions = getExtensions(annotationNode, extensionProviders);
94: 		if (extensions.isEmpty()) return;
95: 		
96: 		new ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(annotationNode, extensions, suppressBaseMethods).replace();
97: 		
98: 		annotationNode.rebuild();
99: 	}

102: 	public List<Extension> getExtensions(final JavacNode typeNode, final List<Object> extensionProviders) {
103: 		List<Extension> extensions = new ArrayList<Extension>();
104: 		for (Object extensionProvider : extensionProviders) {
105: 			if (!(extensionProvider instanceof JCFieldAccess)) continue;
106: 			JCFieldAccess provider = (JCFieldAccess) extensionProvider;
107: 			if (!("class".equals(provider.name.toString()))) continue;
108: 			Type providerType = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, provider.selected);
109: 			if (providerType == null) continue;
110: 			extensions.add(getExtension(typeNode, (ClassType) providerType));
111: 		}
112: 		return extensions;
113: 	}

115: 	public Extension getExtension(final JavacNode typeNode, final ClassType extensionMethodProviderType) {
116: 		List<MethodSymbol> extensionMethods = new ArrayList<MethodSymbol>();
117: 		TypeSymbol tsym = extensionMethodProviderType.asElement();
118: 		JavacNode enclosingType = typeNode;
119: 		Context typeContext = typeNode.getContext();
120: 		JCTree rawNode = typeNode.get();
121: 		Types types = Types.instance(typeContext);
122: 		JCExpression valueExpr = null;
123: 		JCFieldAccess providerAccess = null;
124: 		Type resolvedProvider = null;
125: 		Type methodType = null;
126: 		Type firstArgType = null;
127: 		Type receiverParamType = null;
128: 		Type erasedReceiver = null;
129: 		com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<com.sun.tools.javac.code.Symbol.VarSymbol> params = null;
130: 		com.sun.tools.javac.util.List<Type> argTypes = null;
131: 		com.sun.tools.javac.code.Symbol.VarSymbol receiverParam = null;
132: 		ElementKind kind = null;
133: 		MethodSymbol method = null;
134: 		long methodFlags = 0L;
135: 		long providerFlags = 0L;
136: 		while (enclosingType != null && !(enclosingType.get() instanceof JCClassDecl)) {
137: 			enclosingType = enclosingType.up();
138: 		}
139: 		if (enclosingType != null) {
140: 			typeContext = enclosingType.getContext();
141: 			types = Types.instance(typeContext);
142: 		}
143: 		if (rawNode instanceof JCAnnotation) {
144: 			JCAnnotation annotation = (JCAnnotation) rawNode;
145: 			for (JCExpression arg : annotation.args) {
146: 				valueExpr = arg;
147: 				if (arg instanceof JCAssign) {
148: 					valueExpr = ((JCAssign) arg).rhs;
149: 				}
150: 				if (valueExpr instanceof JCNewArray) {
151: 					valueExpr = ((JCNewArray) valueExpr).elems.head;
152: 				}
153: 				if (valueExpr instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
154: 					providerAccess = (JCFieldAccess) valueExpr;
155: 					resolvedProvider = CLASS.resolveMember(typeNode, providerAccess.selected);
156: 					if (resolvedProvider != null) {
157: 						tsym = resolvedProvider.tsym == tsym ? resolvedProvider.tsym : tsym;
158: 					}
159: 				}
160: 			}
161: 		}
162: 		if (tsym == null) {
163: 			return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);
164: 		}
165: 		providerFlags = tsym.flags();
166: 		if ((providerFlags & (INTERFACE | ANNOTATION)) != 0) {
167: 			return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);
168: 		}
169: 		for (Symbol member : tsym.getEnclosedElements()) {
170: 			kind = member.getKind();
171: 			if (kind != ElementKind.METHOD) {
172: 				continue;
173: 			}
174: 			method = (MethodSymbol) member;
175: 			methodFlags = method.flags();
176: 			if ((methodFlags & (STATIC | PUBLIC)) == 0) {
177: 				continue;
178: 			}
179: 			params = method.params();
180: 			if (params.isEmpty()) {

182: 			}
183: 			receiverParam = params.head;
184: 			receiverParamType = receiverParam.type;
185: 			methodType = method.type;
186: 			argTypes = methodType.getParameterTypes();

190: 				erasedReceiver = types.erasure(receiverParamType);
191: 			}
192: 			extensionMethods.add(method);
193: 		}
194: 		return new Extension(extensionMethods, tsym);

212: 		public ExtensionMethodReplaceVisitor(JavacNode annotationNode, List<Extension> extensions, boolean suppressBaseMethods) {

214: 			this.extensions = extensions;
215: 			this.suppressBaseMethods = suppressBaseMethods;
216: 		}

218: 		public void replace() {

229: 		private void handleMethodCall(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
230: 			JavacNode methodCallNode = annotationNode.getAst().get(methodCall);
231: 			
232: 			if (methodCallNode == null) {
233: 				// This should mean the node does not exist in the source at all. This is the case for generated nodes, such as implicit super() calls.
234: 				return;
235: 			}
236: 			
237: 			JavacNode surroundingType = upToTypeNode(methodCallNode);
238: 			
239: 			TypeSymbol surroundingTypeSymbol = ((JCClassDecl)surroundingType.get()).sym;
240: 			JCExpression receiver = receiverOf(methodCall);
241: 			String methodName = methodNameOf(methodCall);
242: 			
243: 			if ("this".equals(receiver.toString()) || "this".equals(methodName) || "super".equals(methodName)) return;
244: 			Map<JCTree, JCTree> resolution = new JavacResolution(methodCallNode.getContext()).resolveMethodMember(methodCallNode);
245: 			
246: 			JCTree resolvedMethodCall = resolution.get(methodCall);
247: 			if (resolvedMethodCall == null || resolvedMethodCall.type == null) return;
248: 			if (!suppressBaseMethods && !(resolvedMethodCall.type instanceof ErrorType)) return;
249: 			
250: 			JCTree resolvedReceiver = resolution.get(receiver);
251: 			if (resolvedReceiver == null || resolvedReceiver.type == null) return;
252: 			Type receiverType = resolvedReceiver.type;
253: 			
254: 			// Skip static method access
255: 			Symbol sym = null;
256: 			if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCIdent) {
257: 				sym = ((JCIdent) resolvedReceiver).sym;
258: 			} else if (resolvedReceiver instanceof JCFieldAccess) {
259: 				sym = ((JCFieldAccess) resolvedReceiver).sym;
260: 			}
261: 			if (sym instanceof ClassSymbol) return;
262: 			
263: 			Types types = Types.instance(annotationNode.getContext());
264: 			for (Extension extension : extensions) {
265: 				TypeSymbol extensionProvider = extension.extensionProvider;
266: 				if (surroundingTypeSymbol == extensionProvider) continue;
267: 				for (MethodSymbol extensionMethod : extension.extensionMethods) {
268: 					if (!methodName.equals(extensionMethod.name.toString())) continue;
269: 					Type extensionMethodType = extensionMethod.type;
270: 					if (!MethodType.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType) && !ForAll.class.isInstance(extensionMethodType)) continue;
271: 					Type firstArgType = types.erasure(extensionMethodType.asMethodType().argtypes.get(0));
272: 					if (!types.isAssignable(receiverType, firstArgType)) continue;
273: 					methodCall.args = methodCall.args.prepend(receiver);
274: 					methodCall.meth = chainDotsString(annotationNode, extensionProvider.toString() + "." + methodName);
275: 					recursiveSetGeneratedBy(methodCall.meth, methodCallNode);
276: 					return;
277: 				}
278: 			}
279: 		}
280: 		
281: 		private String methodNameOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
282: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
283: 				return ((JCIdent) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
284: 			} else {
285: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).name.toString();
286: 			}
287: 		}
288: 		
289: 		private JCExpression receiverOf(final JCMethodInvocation methodCall) {
290: 			if (methodCall.meth instanceof JCIdent) {
291: 				return annotationNode.getTreeMaker().Ident(annotationNode.toName("this"));
292: 			} else {
293: 				return ((JCFieldAccess) methodCall.meth).selected;
294: 			}

Changed it to require **both** flags: `(methodFlags & STATIC) == 0 || (methodFlags & PUBLIC) == 0`.
